bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Netherlands U21 protect a 3-0 aggregate cushion against desperate Denmark U21.

spf.comment: Covers a home transition victory (2:1) alongside a low-urgency stalemate (1:1) because Jong Oranje's 3-0 aggregate cushion and squad absences make a single win call unnecessary.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.87 combined goal lambda, 54.6% Poisson Over 2.5 baseline, and Denmark's need to commit numbers forward after trailing 3-0.

score.comment: 2:1 captures Dutch transition finishing against an exposed Danish defense, while 1:1 reflects controlled home game management.

goals.comment: 3 goals aligns with our primary 2:1 transition script and 2.87 lambda total, with 2 goals covering the controlled 1:1 stalemate.

bqc.comment: Both sides have high half-time draw rates and strong second-half goal shares, pointing to an even opening half before either a Dutch counter win or shared spoils.
